name: PIA Corporation
summary: PIA Corporation engages in the ticketing, publishing, planning, production, and operation of concerts and events in Japan. The company distributes tickets through online computer ticketing system for music, sports, theater, movie, leisure events, etc., including internet, convenience stores, shops, telephone, and member services. It also publishes books and magazine books; and provides business solutions for corporate clients, including planning sales services and customer management strategies to promotional activities for promoters, event and concert organizers, sports organizations, theater companies, halls, and stadiums.
